description:
Returns the nutrient breakdown for one food at a serving weight.

The result has macros, micronutrients, an assessment against daily
targets, USDA's verbatim ingredient statement when available, and common
portion sizes with their gram weights. ingredients_available is false when
USDA supplied no ingredient statement, which does not mean the food has no
ingredients. assessment.basis is personal_dri when a profile is set and
fda_label_dv otherwise.

grams.description: Serving weight in grams. Defaults to 100.

name: get_food_nutrition
title: Food nutrients
